clips.send: A guy who just bought a $2,000 course sends this to a friend about to buy the same thing, pure anger at being sold a repackaged 1948 idea.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says there is one book behind almost every success guru you have ever paid to learn from: The Magic of Believing, written in 1948.

Pull apart nearly any modern success teacher's training, he says, and you find the same foundational principles - whether that guru ever read the original or not.

He calls it one of the foundational books of success: read it, underline it, read it again, and talk about what actually worked when you tried it.

He says he can name a dozen people who became famous and genuinely wealthy and point to this one book as the reason.

How many "new" success systems have you paid for that were really just this, repackaged?
